DATED : 9th FEBRUARY, 2023 P.C. :
1. Learned AGP waives service for Respondent Nos.1 to 3- State.

2. At the request of the Petitioners, in para 3 on page 9 of the Petition, Gat No.385 stands deleted.
3. Leave to amend to delete Respondent No.21 to 29 in the cause title of the Petition, is granted, as prayed.

6. Respondent Nos.1 to 3 shall file an affidavit in reply within three weeks from the today with a copy to be served upon the Petitioners' Advocate simultaneously.

Advocate simultaneously.

7. The affidavit in reply proposed to be filed by Respondent Nos.1 to 3, shall indicate whether the other contesting Respondents in this petition have applied for disbursement of 911 WP 1526 OF 2023.doc any compensation and if applied, whether Respondent Nos.1 to 3 propose to disburse any amount of compensation in respect to land under acquisition, on next date.
